$comment: audit-prove per-project config schema. OPTIONAL — the skill auto-detects all of this each run (scripts/detect-project.mjs) and writes the resolved values to $SESSION/project.json. Commit a copy named `audit-prove.config.json` at your repo ROOT only when you want to OVERRIDE detection. All paths are repo-root-relative globs.
stack: One-line description, pasted into every agent brief. e.g. 'oRPC routers + Drizzle services, multi-tenant SaaS' / 'Express REST controllers + Prisma' / 'Next.js App Router route handlers + server actions'.
conventions: Optional domain conventions agents should assume. e.g. 'amounts stored as integer cents; tax in basis points'. Empty string if none.

extraChecks.reason: the main turbo gate skips packages that have no check-types script

remediation.$comment: The fix-and-reloop behaviour. Always-on by default; pass --audit-only to skip it (map & gap only).
remediation.$scopeValues: build-and-proof = only get the build green + make proof journeys pass | partial = also finish `partial` findings | full = also implement `missing` findings until the list resolves

fixPolicy.$comment: How fix agents decide HOW to fix: always the best scalable approach within the existing architecture (no new frameworks). `latitude` bounds how far they may change code.
fixPolicy.$latitudeValues: surgical = fix only the target | touched-path = may also refactor the fixed code path for scale, with rationale | aggressive = may also improve closely related code

db.$comment: Persistence verification. verifyMode 'auto' = assert the real persisted row via the DB when reachable, else fall back to API read-back inside the browser session. Direct checks run with `runner` (bun runs TS natively; else 'npx tsx') and reuse `verifyHelper` to reach the right (tenant) DB.
db.testOrgId: <org-uuid the proof logs in / operates as>

$examples.$comment: These show the SAME schema for other stacks. Detection produces one of these shapes automatically — they are here to prove the config is stack-agnostic, not to be merged verbatim.

next-app-router.stack: Next.js App Router route handlers + server actions
